method: split-conformal on the engine's own median, log-ratio residual quantiles
target: months from sanction to the OFFICIAL REVISED completion date
target_caveat: The official revised target, not actual completion; the corpus records no actual completion date for ongoing projects.
population: Projects whose official revised target lies ahead of the as-of date. Overdue projects carry censored, not observed, completion information and are excluded from calibration; for them the displayed P10 is 'no earlier than now' by construction.
measured_on: forecast_project() end to end, floors and monotone rearrangement included
bias_correction_note: exp(q_0.50) = 0.460: the displayed P50 is the raw median times this. Below 1.0 means the raw AFT/earned-value median runs late against official targets; see aft_survival.json 'survivorship'.
